articles.summary: The Longwood Collective launches a multi-modal trip planning app for LMA employees and students with real-time arrivals across LMA Shuttle, MBTA, and Bluebikes.
articles.title: Ontra Mobility and Longwood Collective Launch Commuter App

articles.summary: Fresno partners with Flexlynqs, Ontra Mobility, and Southwest Strategies Group to conduct a Transit On-Demand Feasibility Study aimed at modernizing mobility and expanding access to convenient and equitable transportation options across the region.
articles.title: Ontra Mobility partners with the City of Fresno
